title: Lava Rain
description:
Minecraft but it rains lava!
Try to survive at this really hard challenge!
Resources are limited, can you get them in time before lava gets you?
body:
I initially created this data pack for a video on my YouTube channel, but then I thought I'd share it with everyone!
This can be a very difficult challenge: surviving the lava flow that looms over players, leaving them increasingly less space to move.
Once you've collected your primary resources, hide underground; you can set your own objective! Whether it's collecting a diamond or simply surviving.
To start the game, type **/function lavarain:start**; to stop it, type **/function lavarain:stop**.
If you'd like to use this data pack for videos, go ahead! Just leave the link in the description so others can try it!
**This pack is in italian language!**
